query: I need the cab ventilation filter for a 2012 CASE CX210B, not the engine intake filter.
response_text:
The CASE US catalog confirms this is a **cab filter**, not an engine intake filter, but it shows two unresolved options for the **2012 CASE CX210B**:

- **KHR13340** — quantity 1, callout 95, listed in **09-20 – Air Conditioning – Ducts** ([assembly](https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/heavy-equipment/crawler-excavators/naer24cra312cxb/crawler-excavator-tier-3-na/chassis-attachments/air-conditioning-ducts/cn/7D00FC71-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/28DA6496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6); [product](https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/category/filters/filter-related-parts/cab-filter/p/KHR13340)).
- **KHR13330** — quantity 1, callout 54, listed in **09-22 – Air Conditioning – Evaporator** ([assembly](https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/heavy-equipment/crawler-excavators/naer24cra312cxb/crawler-excavator-tier-3-na/chassis-attachments/air-conditioning-evaporator/cn/D717F67D-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/28DA6496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6); [product](https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/category/filters/filter-related-parts/cab-filter/p/KHR13330)).

The engine-air filters were separately listed and excluded. The catalog evidence is for the CX210B Tier 3, North American production range 01/07–01/19, observed 2026-11-04 ([machine catalog](https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/heavy-equipment/crawler-excavators/naer24cra312cxb/crawler-excavator-tier-3-na/cn/28DA6496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6)). *The catalog does not distinguish these two cab filters by fresh-air/recirculation position, dimensions, or serial range.*

Do you know whether you need the **duct/fresh-air** filter or the **evaporator/recirculation** filter?

query: Find the bucket-link spherical bearing for my CASE CX130 built in 2005.
response_text:
I couldn’t confirm a separately serviced **bucket-link spherical bearing** for the **2005 CASE CX130** in the US catalog.

Both the standard and heavy-duty bucket-link figures show the bucket link as **NSS (not serviced separately)** and do not list a spherical bearing [https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/heavy-equipment/crawler-excavators/naer24cra308cx/case-crawler-excavator-north-america/chassis/bucket-linkage/cn/18D5CF56-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/FFD96496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6] [https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/heavy-equipment/crawler-excavators/naer24cra308cx/case-crawler-excavator-north-america/chassis/bucket-linkage/cn/DF4C315A-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/FFD96496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6]. The catalog’s listed linkage service items are bushings rather than spherical bearings. A catalog-wide search also found no “spherical” bearing entry, though this does not rule out an aftermarket or alternate-market part [https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/dc/searchInModel/part-description?modelCode=FFD96496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6&paramSearch=bucket+spherical+bearing&regionCode=NA] [https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/dc/searchInModel/part-description?modelCode=FFD96496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6&paramSearch=spherical&regionCode=NA] [https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/dc/searchInModel/part-description?modelCode=FFD96496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6&paramSearch=bearing&regionCode=NA].

*Catalog data observed 2026-11-04; serial-specific fitment was not established.* Do you have the machine’s PIN/serial number or can you confirm whether it has the standard or heavy-duty bucket linkage?

key_facts: No confirmed bucket-link spherical bearing was found for the selected CASE CX130 catalog. The inspected standard bucket-link figure 09-46 lists the bucket link itself as NSS (callout 2), rather than a separately serviced bearing; assembly a271, observed 2026-11-04 [https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/heavy-equipment/crawler-excavators/naer24cra308cx/case-crawler-excavator-north-america/chassis/bucket-linkage/cn/18D5CF56-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/FFD96496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6].

The heavy-duty bucket-link figure 09-47 likewise lists the bucket link as NSS (callout 2) and does not list a spherical bearing; assembly a272, observed 2026-11-04 [https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/heavy-equipment/crawler-excavators/naer24cra308cx/case-crawler-excavator-north-america/chassis/bucket-linkage/cn/DF4C315A-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/FFD96496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6].

The linkage service parts shown are bushings—not spherical bearings: 160724A1, 2 required, 65 mm ID × 80 mm OD × 65 mm long; and 150123A1, 2 required, 70 mm ID × 85 mm OD × 70 mm long. These dimensions and quantities occur in both inspected linkage figures [https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/heavy-equipment/crawler-excavators/naer24cra308cx/case-crawler-excavator-north-america/chassis/bucket-linkage/cn/18D5CF56-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/FFD96496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6] [https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/heavy-equipment/crawler-excavators/naer24cra308cx/case-crawler-excavator-north-america/chassis/bucket-linkage/cn/DF4C315A-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/FFD96496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6].

A catalog-wide part-description search for “spherical” returned no results, while the broader “bearing” search only found unrelated assemblies; this is a bounded catalog result, not proof that no aftermarket or alternate part exists [https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/dc/searchInModel/part-description?modelCode=FFD96496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6&paramSearch=bucket+spherical+bearing&regionCode=NA] [https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/dc/searchInModel/part-description?modelCode=FFD96496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6&paramSearch=spherical&regionCode=NA] [https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/dc/searchInModel/part-description?modelCode=FFD96496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6&paramSearch=bearing&regionCode=NA].

query: Which master brake cylinder is listed for a 1985 CASE W20C?
response_text:
The catalog lists **two possible master brake cylinders** for a 1985 CASE W20C, depending on the brake-actuator configuration:

- **N8469 — MASTER CYLINDER**, quantity 1, for actuator assembly **7-58** (“L107985 and L112959 Brake Actuators”). Repair kit: **N6937**. [https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/heavy-equipment/wheel-loaders/naer90whe018w/case-wheel-loader-north-america/brakes/l107985-and-l112959-brake-actuators/cn/53488E5D-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/D8E26496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6]
- **N8695 — hydraulic-cylinder master cylinder**, **200 mm stroke**, quantity 1, for actuator assembly **7-68** (“L113007 Brake Actuator”). Repair kit: **N8937**. [https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/heavy-equipment/wheel-loaders/naer90whe018w/case-wheel-loader-north-america/brakes/l113007-brake-actuator/cn/4D9B6E81-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/D8E26496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6]

The catalog notes that the older L107985/L112959 actuators are no longer available and directs ordering the L113007 actuator, but it does **not** establish that N8469 and N8695 are interchangeable. The North America catalog covers **01/82–12/89**. [https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/heavy-equipment/wheel-loaders/naer90whe018w/case-wheel-loader-north-america/brakes/brake-system-reservoir-to-treadles-and-master-cylinders/cn/C88C7D55-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/D8E26496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6] [https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/heavy-equipment/wheel-loaders/naer90whe018w/case-wheel-loader-north-america/brakes/l107985-and-l112959-brake-actuators/cn/53488E5D-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/D8E26496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6]

Which brake-actuator number is on your machine—**L107985/L112959 or L113007**?

key_facts: The inspected W20C brake-actuator figure is assembly 7-58, “L107985 AND L112959 BRAKE ACTUATORS.” It identifies N8469 as the MASTER CYLINDER for the brake actuator, catalog quantity 1; the catalog says to order repair kit N6937 for service. [https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/heavy-equipment/wheel-loaders/naer90whe018w/case-wheel-loader-north-america/brakes/l107985-and-l112959-brake-actuators/cn/53488E5D-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/D8E26496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6]

A second master-cylinder alternative is in assembly 7-68, “L113007 BRAKE ACTUATOR”: N8695 is a hydraulic-cylinder master cylinder with 200 mm stroke, catalog quantity 1. Its repair kit is N8937; the kit notes that some included components are not used in this actuator. [https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/heavy-equipment/wheel-loaders/naer90whe018w/case-wheel-loader-north-america/brakes/l113007-brake-actuator/cn/4D9B6E81-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/D8E26496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6]

Assembly 7-58 states that the older L107985 and L112959 brake actuators are no longer available and directs ordering L113007 instead. This is an actuator-level service note, not confirmation that N8469 and N8695 are interchangeable. [https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/heavy-equipment/wheel-loaders/naer90whe018w/case-wheel-loader-north-america/brakes/l107985-and-l112959-brake-actuators/cn/53488E5D-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/D8E26496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6]

The displayed direct-substitution relationship for N8469 is 73077613, quantity 1, described as “MASTER CYLINDER.” This is a catalog substitution record and does not independently confirm serial-specific fitment. [https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/cn/assemblyRemanAltsSubModal?productCode=N8469]

The two master-cylinder candidates remain unresolved without the machine’s brake-actuator configuration or serial/PIN: N8469 with N6937 applies to the 7-58 actuator listing, while N8695 with N8937 applies to the 7-68 L113007 actuator listing. The research used the W20C North America catalog dated 01/82–12/89, observed 2026-11-04; assembly-source completeness is not established. [https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/heavy-equipment/wheel-loaders/naer90whe018w/case-wheel-loader-north-america/brakes/brake-system-reservoir-to-treadles-and-master-cylinders/cn/C88C7D55-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/D8E26496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6] [https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/heavy-equipment/wheel-loaders/naer90whe018w/case-wheel-loader-north-america/brakes/l107985-and-l112959-brake-actuators/cn/53488E5D-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/D8E26496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6] [https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/heavy-equipment/wheel-loaders/naer90whe018w/case-wheel-loader-north-america/brakes/l113007-brake-actuator/cn/4D9B6E81-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/D8E26496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6]

parent_completions.text:
The catalog lists **two possible master brake cylinders** for a 1985 CASE W20C, depending on the brake-actuator configuration:

- **N8469 — MASTER CYLINDER**, quantity 1, for actuator assembly **7-58** (“L107985 and L112959 Brake Actuators”). Repair kit: **N6937**. [url_2]
- **N8695 — hydraulic-cylinder master cylinder**, **200 mm stroke**, quantity 1, for actuator assembly **7-68** (“L113007 Brake Actuator”). Repair kit: **N8937**. [url_5]

The catalog notes that the older L107985/L112959 actuators are no longer available and directs ordering the L113007 actuator, but it does **not** establish that N8469 and N8695 are interchangeable. The North America catalog covers **01/82–12/89**. [url_1] [url_2]

Which brake-actuator number is on your machine—**L107985/L112959 or L113007**?

query: For a 1998 CASE 1840, can you identify the engine oil filter?
response_text:
For the 1998 CASE 1840 with the standard 4-390 engine, the engine oil filter is **J908616**, quantity 1 ([assembly verification](https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/light-equipment/skid-steer-loaders/naes77ski007uni-loader/case-uni-loader-skid-steer-loader/engine/oil-filter-and-cooler-4-390-engine/cn/C88A796F-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/C9CB6496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6); [product](https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/category/filters/oil-filters/engine-oil-filter/p/J908616)). A 12-filter package is listed as **J908616MP**.

For the emissions-certified 4-390 engine, **J908616** is also listed, marked “If Used” ([assembly verification](https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/light-equipment/skid-steer-loaders/naes77ski007uni-loader/case-uni-loader-skid-steer-loader/engine/oil-filter-and-cooler-4-390-emissions-certified-engine/cn/0316EF83-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/C9CB6496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6)). A premium alternative, **J934429**, is likewise listed as “If Used” ([assembly verification](https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/light-equipment/skid-steer-loaders/naes77ski007uni-loader/case-uni-loader-skid-steer-loader/engine/oil-filter-and-cooler-4-390-emissions-certified-engine/cn/0316EF83-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/C9CB6496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6); [product](https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/category/filters/oil-filters/engine-oil-filter/p/J934429)).

*Catalog evidence observed 2026-11-04; it does not establish serial-specific fitment or inventory. Is your machine equipped with the standard or emissions-certified 4-390 engine, and is the premium filter option fitted?*

key_facts: Engine air-cleaner assembly 2-012 — AIR CLEANER (referenced by both air-induction figures 2-008, prior to P.I.N. JJA0033579, and 2-010, P.I.N. JJA0033579 and after) lists two elements: A171255, primary element, catalog quantity 1, product https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/caseih/category/filters/air-filters/air-filter/p/A171255; and A171256, secondary element, 127 mm ID × 151 mm OD × 355.6 mm L, catalog quantity 1, product https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/caseih/category/filters/air-filters/air-filter/p/A171256. Evidence: assembly a28, https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/caseih/na/tractors/agricultural/naaa01agr100magnum7100series/case-ih-magnum-tractor/engine/air-cleaner/cn/7A6C387F-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/FCD26496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6; routing evidence: a26/https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/caseih/na/tractors/agricultural/naaa01agr100magnum7100series/case-ih-magnum-tractor/engine/air-induction-system-prior-to-pin-jja0033579/cn/22612542-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/FCD26496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6 and a27/https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/caseih/na/tractors/agricultural/naaa01agr100magnum7100series/case-ih-magnum-tractor/engine/air-induction-system-pin-jja0033579-and-after/cn/2D2B7A75-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/FCD26496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6.

A171256 has displayed direct-substitution records from P2950547 and R2950547, each quantity 1; these are catalog replacement records, not an independent fitment or interchangeability determination. Evidence: https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/caseih/cn/assemblyRemanAltsSubModal?productCode=A171256.

A171255 has displayed direct-substitution records from P2950546 and Q2950546, each quantity 1; these are catalog replacement records, not an independent fitment or interchangeability determination. Evidence: https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/caseih/cn/assemblyRemanAltsSubModal?productCode=A171255.

The selected catalog is the dated, partial 7150 catalog for production range 01/87–12/93; the exact pre/post-P.I.N. air-induction applicability cannot be narrowed without the tractor P.I.N. or serial number.

query: I need a pickup tine for my 2004 Case IH RBX462 baler.
response_text:
The US catalog includes the **2004 Case IH RBX462** (production range 01/03–12/05), but “pickup tine” is ambiguous because this baler has several pickup configurations:

- **2M straight-and-curved reel:** pickup center straight tine **86626599**, catalog quantity 32. [https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/caseih/na/balers/round-balers/naad72rou022rbx/case-ih-round-baler/feeder/2m-wide-pickup-reel-straight-curved-pickup-tines/cn/48498E5D-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/6DE06496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6]
- **2M curved pickup:** coiled 2-prong tine, 186.5 mm long—**87394242** (premium/standard) or **87607074** (economy/optional), catalog quantity 64. [https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/caseih/na/balers/round-balers/naad72rou022rbx/case-ih-round-baler/feeder/2m-wide-pickup-reel-curved-pickup-tines/cn/A0499851-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/6DE06496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6]
- **1.8M windguard upper pickup:** tine bar **87033640**; the applicable version depends on the PIN/serial break. [https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/caseih/na/balers/round-balers/naad72rou022rbx/case-ih-round-baler/feeder/18m-wide-pickup-windguard-upper-prior-to-pin-hbj039250/cn/378FBA70-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/6DE06496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6] [https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/caseih/na/balers/round-balers/naad72rou022rbx/case-ih-round-baler/feeder/18m-wide-pickup-windguard-upper-pin-hbj039251-after/cn/2A418E5D-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/6DE06496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6]

Which pickup does your baler have: **1.8M windguard, 2M straight-and-curved reel, or 2M curved pickup**? *Catalog quantities are not stock quantities.*

For the 2M curved pickup configuration inspected in assembly 13.431 (https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/caseih/na/balers/round-balers/naad72rou022rbx/case-ih-round-baler/feeder/2m-wide-pickup-reel-curved-pickup-tines/cn/A0499851-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/6DE06496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6), the curved tine alternatives are 87394242, premium/standard, and 87607074, economy/optional. Product URLs are https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/caseih/category/hay-forage/forage-parts/torsion-spring/p/87394242 and https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/caseih/category/hay-forage/forage-parts/tine/p/87607074.

query: What is included in the tailgate cylinder seal kit for a 2004 Case IH RBX562?
response_text:
The US Case IH catalog does not list the individual contents of the seal kit. It shows two possible tailgate-lift cylinder kits for a 2004 RBX562:

- **Old-style cylinder:** seal kit **86586336**, catalog quantity **AR**, callout 14 ([product](https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/caseih/category/seals-o-rings/seal-kits/seal-kit/p/86586336); [assembly verification](https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/caseih/na/balers/round-balers/naad72rou022rbx/case-ih-round-baler/hydraulic-system/hydraulic-cylinder-tailgate-lift-old-style/cn/C9C4E746-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/72E06496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6)).
- **New-style cylinder:** seal kit **87025443**, catalog quantity **AR**, callout 14 ([product](https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/caseih/category/hydraulics/cylinders/seal-kit/p/87025443); [assembly verification](https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/caseih/na/balers/round-balers/naad72rou022rbx/case-ih-round-baler/hydraulic-system/hydraulic-cylinder-tailgate-lift-new-style/cn/C8CDE746-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/72E06496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6)).

Both inspected listings have no serial restrictions, but the catalog does not identify which cylinder style is installed on your machine or provide the kit’s individual seal contents. *The catalog information is from the US source and does not establish the contents beyond the seal-kit listing.*

Can you confirm whether your cylinder is the old or new style, or provide the part number stamped on it?
